items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I used Sonny Henry's trombone, one of them.

ctx.x: I didn't know him but I heard all about him.

He was number one trombone player. They had me way on the end. He was playing first parts, I was playing third, way around the end. People was coming with those old trombone cases, you know. You open the top and pull the horn out of that way. I've never seen so many instruments in all days of my life, funny instruments in all days of my life on that WPA band. So when we moved over to Tulane Club, they had an examination. You understand, Mr. Martinez and I happened to be, I happened to walk, he sent for me. I…
I knocked the tempo off and he goes, da da da da da da da da da da da.
